items.caption:
Your talking-head Reels feel boring for one reason: you stood in one spot.

Same frame for 30 seconds and the brain checks out.

Switch location every line. New background each sentence. It reads as energy and pace even when the words are the same.

items.caption:
Most editors take 4 hours per Reel. My workflow is 18 minutes.

Import → cut → captions → music → export.

The time doesn't leak inside those steps. It leaks between them — hunting for music, redoing captions, second-guessing cuts. Kill the in-between and the edit flies.

Follow @josephborroto — I share the systems, not just the highlight.

items.caption:

That's the "why am I still watching this" moment. If nothing specific lands right there, they're gone.

The fix: a number, a name, or a contradiction at second 4. Specificity buys you the next 10 seconds.
